dedupe_keys.name: code and results for meeting equity requirements in shared micromobility rebalancing

description: Lorenzo Rota and colleagues publish code and trained policies for equity-aware shared-micromobility rebalancing. The Zenodo archive is public under MIT and describes a constrained Markov decision process, synthetic scenario experiments and a case study in The Hague. Configuration files and selected outputs support tests of how vehicle redistribution changes service equity and operational performance. This model can be adapted to compare rebalancing rules in a simulation of a shared fleet. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the thesis-specific package; the cited FairMSS repository is identified as a source, not as the same release. Coverage is synthetic cases and The Hague inputs, not every operator or city. A limitation is that restricted raw data are not redistributed, so full calibration and some case reconstruction depend on separate access terms. The thesis label is not evidence of publication as a journal article. The archive was not downloaded, code was not run and policy performance was not independently verified.
